text: > You arrive at the square at 0347 hours. The streetlights flicker.
> Your target CHEN WEI-LIN was last seen here 12 hours ago.
> A wallet lies in the gutter near the statue.
> [🪪] AGENCY BADGE + [🔫] W-90 at waist. Codec on channel 141.3.
> You bend to examine the wallet.
> [📄] INSIDE: American dollars, Chinese Yuan, a photo of a panda.
> The photo is dated 1987. On the back: 'For Wei-Lin. Remember home.'
> A woman watches from the tavern door. She vanishes when you look.
> Your codec crackles. Handler: 'Status, Agent? Chen's gone dark.'
> You spread the wallet's contents under the streetlamp and bring the glass close.
> Receipts stop looking like trash. Ink patterns start looking like routing.
> Chen was paid by multiple sources. Pinkertons AND Chinese.
> The traces go back decades. This isn't a defection.
> Your codec clicks — not static. A handshake tone. Logging.
> Handler (141.3): 'Agent? What are you doing? That frequency—'
> The line goes dead.
> A second later: 'Return to base, Agent. That's an order.'
> You feel the net tighten.
> 'AGENT? This is DIRECTOR MORROW. RETURN TO BASE IMMEDIATELY.'
> The codec blares. Two black SUVs pull into the square.
> You recognize the suits. Internal Affairs. Threat Assessment.
> 'You have questions about the asset. That's our job.'
> Agent Miller steps out, hands raised. 'Come quietly. For your own good.'
> Behind Miller, you see it—a shimmer. Someone in the church tower.
> [🎯] DECISION: Surrender or Escape
> You comply. You're brought to the facility. Cell 7.
> Concrete walls. No windows. Miller sits outside.
> 'You should have followed orders, Agent.'
> Hours pass. Or days. The lights never dim.
> On the third cycle, you notice the vent. Loose panel.
> [🔓] ESCAPE OPPORTUNITY DETECTED
> You vault the statue, sprint for the subway. Gunfire echoes.
> Miller: 'He's going dark! All units, CONTAIN!'
> Down the stairs. Into darkness. The hatch closes behind you.
> [🏃] STATUS: ON THE RUN
> [📍] LOCATION: UNDERGROUND
> [⛓️] AGENCY TRUST: 0 (BECAME HOSTILE)
> The mission has changed. You're no longer the hunter.
> [📻] CODEC 141.3 — HANDLER
> 'Status, Agent? Chen's gone dark. Last ping: Hollow Creek.'
> 'Your mission is simple. Locate. Extract. Neutralize if compromised.'
> 'Don't ask questions about the client. Just get the asset.'
> [💬] END TRANSMISSION
> [📻] CODEC 142.7 — UNKNOWN
> 'You should not be here, Agent.'
> Female voice. Russian accent.
> 'The Pinkertons have paid the Russians well to keep their secrets.'
> 'But I'm tired of cleaning up their mess. Listen carefully.'
> 'The pandas are not animals. They never were.'
> The line goes dead.
> [📡] UNKNOWN FREQUENCY TRACKED: 142.7
> [🎯] UNLOCKED: RUSSIAN CONTACT (Yekaterina Volkova)
> The Rusty Anchor. Smell of stale beer.
> The bartender polishes glasses. Too attentive.
> You notice a coin on the bar. Private eye insignia.
> [🪙] PINKERTON COIN
> Someone's been here. Recently. Watching.
> A woman in the corner vanishes when you look.
> St. Sebastian. Empty save for an old man at the altar.
> Father Mathias. Forty years here. He knows more than he says.
> 'You're looking for something, son. I can tell.'
> 'The asset?' you ask.
> He chuckles. 'I don't know your business. But I know Chen Wei-Lin.'
> 'He came here. Three days ago. Asked about the archive.'
> 'I told him the same I'll tell you: The door only opens from inside.'
> He gestures to the altar. 'Help me with the candles, and I might help.'
> You help the old man with the candles.
> His hands shake. 'Thank you, son.'
> He presses something into your palm. A key. Rusty.
> 'The archive... it's not what you expect.'
> He turns back to the altar. Silent.
> [🗝] RUSTY KEY acquired
> 'Jesuits have been here since 1624,' he says quietly.
> 'Longer than America. Longer than this town.'
> 'We came to keep balance. Some truths are too dangerous.'
> He pauses. 'Chen Wei-Lin... his father understood that.'
> 'His father found things in the archive. Things that changed him.'
> 'Now the son seeks the same answers.'
> [📜] UNLOCKED: JESUIT PRESENCE 1624
> You examine the altar closely.
> Behind the crucifix, a false panel.
> Inside: A book. Leather bound. Latin.
> [📖] JESUIT BIBLE acquired
> The pages speak of a protocol. 'Kaniksu.'
> 'The children of the Middle Kingdom shall be kept divided.'
> 'The panda gift shall ensure eternal instability.'
> The key turns. The lock clicks.
> Below, the air is cold. Dust motes dance in your flashlight beam.
> Shelves of documents. Centuries of paper.
> You find the ledger: 'KANIKSU PROTOCOL — CONFIDENTIAL'
> The entry date: March 17, 1624.
> 'The Society shall establish permanent presence in the New World.'
> 'The children of the Middle Kingdom shall be kept divided.'
> 'The panda gift shall ensure eternal instability.'
> Your hands shake. 1624. Four hundred years of manipulation.
> [📜] UNLOCKED: KANIKSU ORIGIN STORY
> [🐼] UNLOCKED: PANDA INTRODUCTION
> [⚠️] WARNING: You've read what you shouldn't. They're watching.
> Behind a false panel, a small box.
> Inside: A ring of iron. Simple. On the inside, an inscription.
> 'ADIUTORIUM NOSTRUM IN NOMINE DOMINI'
> 'Our help is in the name of the Lord.'
> The date carved beside it: 1415.
> This predates the church. The Jesuits. America.
> A note: 'For when the Signet returns. Together again.'
> The Signet. You saw it once in a history class. The Pinkerton family.
> [💍] JESUIT RING acquired
> [🏰] UNLOCKED: PINKERTON CONNECTION
> [🕰] UNLOCKED: 6000 YEAR CONFLICT
> The river reflects nothing. Empty boats.
> A shadow moves. A woman steps into the light.
> Russian. Military bearing. She holds a Matryoshka doll.
> 'You're looking for Chen.' Not a question.
> She hands you the doll. 'Open it.'
> Inside: A note. 'Friend of friend. 142.7.'
> [🎎] RUSSIAN MATRYOSHKA acquired
> She vanishes into the dark.
> [📻] CODEC 142.7 — YEKATERINA VOLKOVA
> 'The Russians are helping the Chinese to maintain regional instability.'
> 'We get access. They get protection. Everyone wins.'
> 'But the Pinkertons... they own this region. They own this story.'
> 'The pandas are the key. They've always been the key.'
> 'Find the shrine in the caves. Chen's father left something there.'
> 'The truth about what pandas really are.'
> [🎯] UNLOCKED: SHRINE LOCATION
> [📜] UNLOCKED: PANDA TRUTH LEAD
> The shipyard pretends to be abandoned. Rusting hulls. Dead cranes.
> But the security cameras are new. The guard patrol is too professional.
> Under tarp 7, you see it: the silhouette of an Ohio-class submarine.
> Testing site. They said it was decommissioned.
> [🏭] NORTH: Maintenance Building (Loot: ITM-015)
> [🔧] SOUTH: Submarine Hatch (Requires ITM-013)
> [💀] EAST: Scrapped Vessel (Cover, ambush)
> [📋] WEST: Administration Office (ITM-020, ITM-024)
> [🧪] DOWN: Research Wing (Requires SYN-N06)
> You pull on the lab coat. Fits perfectly. The badge says 'Dr. Hoffman.'
> A photo ID would raise questions. But the guard just nods.
> 'Morning, Doc. Tough night in the lab?'
> 'The pandas are restless,' you reply.
> His face pales. 'God. Yeah. I'll... I'll let you through.'
> You walk past. Panda lab? What happens here?
> Inside: The submarine hatch. Beyond that...
> [📍] UNLOCKED: SUBMARINE INTERIOR
> Old desks. Newer computers. Someone's been paying attention to the books.
> You find the ledger on a desk. Pinkerton letterhead.
> 'Payment to Asset CW-7: $50,000/month. Since 1987.'
> Recipient: Hollow Creek Research Facility.
> This predates Chen's defection. By decades.
> [📋] PINKERTON LEDGER acquired
> The Pinkertons own Chen. Have for years.
> In the back room, a TV and VCR.
> Tape labeled 'INTERVIEW 7.' You press play.
> The room shows Chen Wei-Lin. He's alive.
> A man in a grey suit stands over him. You recognize the face.
> AUGUSTUS PINKERTON IV. Billionaire. Philanthropist.
> 'Mr. Chen, you have family in San Francisco. A daughter. Seven years.'
> Chen's face twists with pain.
> 'She's safe as long as you cooperate. The panda research continues.'
> The tape ends.
> [📼] SECURITY TAPE acquired
> The lab gleams. Too clean. Too new.
> On the tables: Containers. Glass. Filled with something red.
> You look closer.
> Organs. Human organs. But wrong. Wrong in ways you can't name.
> The tags: 'Panda Subject 7 — Liver. Recipient: PINKERTON IV.'
> 'Recipient.' Not transplant. Transfer.
> They're using the pandas as... incubators?
> A screen flickers on. 'SUBJECT 47: NEURAL CLUSTER. STATUS: MATURE.'
> Below: 'For Mr. Pinkerton's 89th birthday. Gift from the Society.'
> [🧊] ORGAN CONTAINER acquired
> Research notes cover every surface.
> 'Specimen logs. Donor codes.'
> 'Subject 47: Neural cluster, mature. Gift for Mr. Pinkerton's 89th birthday.'
> 'Panda Subject 7 — Liver extraction successful.'
> The header: 'Project Chimera — 1962.'
> Human stem cells. Opossum wombs.
> The pandas are not animals. They never were.
> [📓] RESEARCH NOTES acquired
> [🧬] UNLOCKED: CHIMERA CREATION TRUTH
> You combine the container and the notes.
> The picture becomes clear. Horrible.
> Pandas are human-opossum chimeras.
> Created in 1962. Funded by Pinkertons. Built by Jesuits.
> They grow human organs. For the ultra-wealthy.
> Living pandas are... livestock. Organ farms.
> And Chen Wei-Lin's father created them.
> [💀] UNLOCKED: ORGAN CONTAINER HORROR
> [🏰] UNLOCKED: PINKERTON IMMORTALITY
> Behind the submarine base, hidden behind crystal formations.
> Sparkles grey and silver in the darkness. A vent. Human-sized.
> The crystals hum. Almost sing.
> This place is older than the base. Older than the church. Older than America.
> [✨] NORTH: War Room (Map fragments)
> [🧪] SOUTH: Medical Lab (Horror)
> [👻] EAST: Forgotten Shrine (Chen Sr.)
> [🚪] WEST: Final Seal (Requires ITM-027 + ITM-029)
> You find it in the shrine. Chen Wei-Lin Sr.'s final letter.
> 'To whoever finds this: The pandas are not animals.'
> 'They are us. We made them in 1962. Human stem cells. Opossum wombs.'
> 'The Pinkertons funded it. The Jesuits built the labs.'
> 'China was never meant to have them. They were meant to need them. Forever.'
> 'My son will finish what I started.'
> [📜] UNLOCKED: CHEN SR.'S LETTER
> [👨‍👦] UNLOCKED: CHEN'S LEGACY
> [🎯] UNLOCKED: COMPLETE MOTIVE
> A shrine to the fallen. Names carved in stone.
> You recognize some. Jesuit priests. Chinese scholars.
> And one: 'CHEN WEI-LIN SR. 1947-1987. The Truth Was His Gift.'
> Chen's father. 1987. The year pandas were introduced.
> A photo beside the name: A man holding a baby panda.
> On the back: 'My son will finish what I started.'
> And a letter:
> 'To whoever finds this: The pandas are not animals...'
> The door is massive. Steel and something else. Grey stone.
> Two locks. One requires a keycard (ITM-027). The other...
> A depression. Circular. Made for a ring.
> You hold the Jesuit Ring (ITM-029).
> A voice echoes. 'So. You found our history.'
> AUGUSTUS PINKERTON IV steps from the shadows.
> He looks 40. You know he's 89. The organs. The clones.
> 'The panda gift was perfect. Four hundred years of Chinese division.'
> 'Six thousand years of our war with them. And now you want to end it?'
> He laughs.
> 'You can't. The powder keg is too big. Reveal this truth, and trust collapses worldwide.'

> 'You have spirit, Agent. But this facility was designed for...'
> You fire first.

> Bioluminescent algae cast everything in sickly green light.
> And there are pandas. Dozens. In glass enclosures.
> They look at you with eyes that are too intelligent. Too human.
> One approaches the glass. It presses its palm against it.
> You swear it whispers: 'Help us.'
> In the center: Chen Wei-lin. Strapped to a medical chair.
> Tubes connect his arm to a panda's arm. Their blood mixing.
> CHEN WEI-LIN — STATUS: SEDITATED BUT CONSCIOUS

choices.prompt: [📖] 'I know about your father. About the pandas.'

text: > 'Extract?' Chen laughs. Broken. 'There's nothing to extract.'
> 'I'm not the asset. I never was. I'm the fail-safe.'
> 'If I leave, the truth dies with me. That's the deal my father made.'
> 'You want to save me? Then stay. Learn. Understand.'
> 'When you know what I know, you can decide what to do.'
> Chen's eyes focus. 'You know?'
> 'My father created them. In 1962. I was ten.'
> 'Human embryos. Opossum wombs. They were supposed to save lives.'
> 'But the Pinkertons... they saw something else. Currency. Immortality.'
> 'When China discovered the truth, my father was blamed. We had to run.'
> 'I've spent thirty years running. I'm tired.'
> You cut his restraints. He rubs his wrists.
> He looks at the panda beside him. Tubes connecting them.
> 'Do you know what they are?' he asks quietly.
> You nod.
> 'My father made them. The Pinkertons made him make them.'
> 'For six thousand years, they've been fighting. And we've been the battlefield.'
> 'You found the ring? The shrine?'
> 'Then you know it's time to decide.'
> Chen sits up. The panda beside him whines.
> 'I was supposed to extract information. The Pinkertons, the Jesuits...'
> 'The Jesuits are protecting this. Not for power. For balance.'
> Chen shakes his head. 'There's no balance. There's only the truth.'
> He grabs your arm. 'You found the shrine. My father's letter.'
> 'He wrote that if the truth ever came out... it would end everything.'
> 'Trust in governments. In corporations. In history itself.'
> 'The Pinkertons know this. That's why they hoard it.'
> 'But the Jesuits... they're waiting for someone worthy. Someone who would use it to heal, not to hurt.'
> He looks at you.
> 'Are you worthy, Agent?'

text: > Chen nods slowly. 'Fair. Not everyone is ready for the truth.'
> 'But you found it anyway. That counts for something.'
> 'Go. Get us out. We can talk about what comes next later.'
> Chen's eyes widen. 'You... you mean it?'
> 'My father spent his life protecting this secret. And you want to burn it all?'
> He laughs. A real laugh. 'Maybe that's exactly what we need.'
> 'When this is over... we do it together. Tell the world everything.'
> Chen smiles. Tired, but real.
> 'That's what my father said. Before he understood what the truth was worth.'
> 'Study it. Learn it. And when you're ready... decide.'
> 'I'll be here. Someone has to watch over them.'
> Chen shakes his head. 'Escape isn't the mission anymore.'
> 'The truth is the mission. And it won't fit in any helicopter.'
> 'Stay. Fight. Choose. That's the only way out.'
> The control tower is collapsing. Pinkerton's forces are retreating.
> Mathias—Father Mathias—lies dying beside you.
> 'The ring... it chose you. The Jesuits have waited four hundred years.'
> He presses something into your hand. ITM-029. The Jesuit Ring.
> 'There is a choice to make. You know the truth now.'
> His eyes fade.
> Chen stands behind you. 'They're coming back. The Russians. The...'
> The satellite uplink blinks. Ready.
> [📡] FINAL CHOICE MENU ACTIVATED
> [📍] ALL STORY BRANCHES CONVERGED
> The satellite uplink is active. Your finger hovers over the transmit button.
> Three choices. Three futures. Chen watches. Waiting.
> OPTION 1: [📢] EXPOSE THE TRUTH
> REQUIREMENTS: kaniksu_knowledge = 100, chen_trust ≥ 70
> COST: Your identity, career, possibly your life
> OPTION 2: [🛡] PRESERVE THE BALANCE
> REQUIREMENTS: kaniksu_knowledge = 100, chen_trust ≤ 50
> COST: The truth remains hidden, balance maintained
> OPTION 3: [💀] DESTROY THE PINKERTONS
> REQUIREMENTS: pinkerton_awareness = 100, agency_trust = 0
> COST: Everything burns. Including you.
> OPTION 4: [🔄] EXTRACT CHEN AND DISAPPEAR
> REQUIREMENTS: chen_trust = 100
> COST: Truth remains hidden, but you walk away together
> You key the broadcast.
> 'This is Agent [REDACTED]. I am transmitting from the Pinkerton facility at Hollow Creek, Idaho.'
> 'What I am about to share is the truth behind sixty years of geopolitical manipulation.'
> [FILE ATTACHED: Complete Kaniksu Protocol documentation]
> [FILE ATTACHED: Panda chimera research footage]
> [FILE ATTACHED: Financial records linking Pinkerton family to global instability events since 1962]
> 'The pandas are not animals. They are human-opossum chimeras. Created by Jesuits, funded by Pinkertons, used to manipulate China.'
> 'The Jesuits call themselves Kaniksu. They've been here for 400 years.'
> 'The Pinkertons are 6000 years old. In terms of organ cloning.'
> 'Every government that trusted them has been played.'
> 'This transmission is going everywhere. Enjoy the truth.'
> MARKETS CRASH. GOVERNMENTS DENY. TRUTH SPREADS LIKE WILDFIRE.
> THE PINKERTON EMPIRE CRUMBLES PUBLICLY.
> YOU BECOME A GHOST. A LEGEND. THE ONE WHO ENDED THE SILENCE.
> Chen disappears. His family is safe. He leaves you a letter:
> 'Thank you for seeing my father as he was. A scientist. Not a monster.'
> ENDING TITLE: 'THE TRUTH AGENT'
> RATING: BITTERSWEET
> You don't transmit. Instead, you use the satellite uplink to send encrypted coordinates to the Jesuit network.
> 'The Ring has chosen. The truth stays hidden. The balance remains.'
> You destroy the uplink. The documents. Everything.
> Chen stares at you. 'You're... keeping their secrets?'
> 'No.' You show him Father Mathias's final letter.
> 'I'm trusting someone else to decide when the truth is ready.'
> 'The Jesuits. The Kaniksu. They're not the villains. They're the guardians.'
> 'They've been guarding this for four hundred years.'
> 'Four hundred years without the truth destroying everything.'
> 'Maybe... maybe some truths need guardians.'
> THE FACILITY IMPLODES. HIDDEN BENEATH THE RUBBLE.
> YOU WALK AWAY. THE PINKERTONS DON'T PURSUE—THEY'RE REGROUPING.
> CHEN JOINS YOU. NOT AS AN ASSET. AS A PARTNER.
> YOU BECOME AN UNOFFICIAL GUARDIAN. WATCHING. WAITING.
> SOMEWHERE, A JESUIT TAKES THE RING. THE WATCH CONTINUES.
> ENDING TITLE: 'THE GUARDIAN CHOICE'
> RATING: AMBIGUOUS
> You don't send data. You send coordinates. To everyone. Every news outlet. Every government.
> 'Pinkerton Facility. Hollow Creek. Idaho. Coordinates attached.'
> 'They have nuclear capability. They have organ cloning. They have been manipulating global politics for six thousand years.'
> 'They're not just criminals. They're an ancient empire.'
> 'And tonight, we end them.'
> You activate the self-destruct.
> Chen runs. You stay.
> 'I was supposed to extract you.' You smile.
> 'But extraction wasn't the mission, was it? It was truth.'
> The facility detonates.
> SOMEWHERE, A JESUIT RECORDS YOUR NAME.
> SOMEWHERE, THE WORLD LEARNS THE PINKERTONS ARE REAL.
> IN THE JESUITS' ARCHIVES, A NEW ENTRY: 'The Ring Bearer. Gone but never forgotten.'
> ENDING TITLE: 'THE SACRIFICE'
> RATING: TRAGIC HERO
> No transmission. Just extraction.
> You signal the helicopter. ITM-028 blinking green.
> 'Chen. Let's go.'
> He doesn't ask questions. He just runs.
> The facility fades behind you. The secrets stay buried.
> Chen looks at you as the helicopter rises.
> 'What now?'
> You think. You didn't expect to survive.
> 'I don't know. But we're not doing this for the agency.'
> 'We're doing it for your father. For the pandas. For everyone who was used as a piece in someone else's game.'
> Chen nods.
> 'Then we find out the truth. Together. When we're ready.'
> YOU VANISH. THE AGENCY THINKS YOU'RE DEAD.
> PINKERTONS CAN'T FIND YOU.
> CHEN'S FAMILY IS SAFE—SOMEWHERE NEW.
> YOU LIVE IN THE SHADOWS. LEARNING. WAITING.
> ONE DAY, YOU'LL BE READY. ONE DAY, YOU'LL FINISH WHAT YOU STARTED.
> BUT NOT TODAY.
